name: AI Chatbot for Heyloha
author: INVESL

sections.description:
AI Chatbot for Heyloha allows you to embed an AI-powered assistant directly into your WordPress site using a simple Brand ID.
This plugin is for businesses and professionals who use the Heyloha platform to deliver personalized and intelligent chatbot experiences to website visitors.

Note: An active Heyloha license is required to use the chatbot.
Without a license, the chatbot will not load.

Key Features:

  • Installs directly from the WordPress plugin library
  • Requires only your Heyloha Brand ID (UUID) to activate
  • No technical skills needed
  • Fully managed via Heyloha (no manual coding)
  • Control which pages the chatbot appears on via your Heyloha dashboard
  • Customize the chatbot’s knowledge, tone, and appearance per brand
  • Lightweight and automatically embedded across your website

Support

For support, contact: support@heyloha.ai

External Services

This plugin connects to an external JavaScript file hosted at https://agent.heyloha.ai.

The script is necessary to embed the Heyloha AI Agent (chat assistant) into your website. It enables real-time communication between visitors and the Heyloha AI platform.

Data sent to the service:
– The configured brand ID is passed as a query parameter in the embed URL (e.g., ?brand=123).
– No personal user data is sent directly by the plugin, but the script may collect interaction data as per Heyloha’s privacy policy.

This service is provided by Heyloha (operated by INVESL B.V.).

  • Terms of Service: https://heyloha.ai/voorwaarden
  • Privacy Policy: https://heyloha.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for AI Chatbot for Heyloha and install the plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to Settings > AI Chatbot for Heyloha and enter your Brand ID.
  5. The chatbot will be automatically injected on your site based on the configuration set in your Heyloha environment.
sections.faq:
Where can I find my Brand ID?

Log in to your Heyloha environment at https://app.heyloha.ai.
Go to your Brand Settings to find your unique Brand ID.

Can I control where the chatbot appears?

Yes. In your Heyloha dashboard, you can define on which pages or paths the chatbot should be displayed.

Can I change the chatbot’s knowledge or behavior?

Absolutely. You can manage the chatbot’s knowledge base, tone of voice, personality, and behavior from within your Heyloha license dashboard.
